notes: The estimate now models the FICA caps: Social Security stops at the 2026 wage base of $184,500 (max $11,439/year at 6.2%), and Medicare adds the 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on wages over $200,000. At $4,000/week the estimate was overstating Social Security by $1,457/year and understating Medicare by $72/year. At ordinary wages nothing changes; with a pay stub saved, nothing changes.
